Backtest accuracy · blind, scored against published setlists
Jul 22 · #92 · '92 theme · model v17 / 20
Jul 24 · #93 · '93 theme · model v210 / 20
Model v1 keyed on tour recency and scored 7/20. v2 threw recency out and mapped the MSG show number to a year — #92 played a 1992 setlist, #93 a 1993 one — then spent every slot on that year's rotation minus songs already used in the run. That scored 10/20. v3 adds two fixes from the 7/24 misses: rank within the theme year's album by live frequency rather than album prominence, and reserve a quarter of the slots for era covers and set-pieces (eight of the 24 songs on 7/24 were era covers, and v2 predicted none of them).
